changelog:
Initial release of meme-rush skill — a fast-trading assistant for meme tokens.

- Provides real-time lists of new, finalizing, and just-migrated meme tokens from multiple launchpads.
- AI-powered discovery of market hot topics with ranked associated tokens by net inflow.
- Advanced filtering: liquidity, market cap, holder distribution, dev/insider activity.
- Covers tokens and topics from Pump.fun, Four.meme, and more on Solana and BSC.
- Supports both lifecycle tracking and narrative trading use cases for meme tokens.
